themes.title: Far-right push for 'national priority' policies
themes.blurb: Right-wing and far-right parties across Europe are intensifying demands for policies that prioritize nationals in housing, employment, and social benefits. This theme appears in Spain, Italy, Poland, France, and the UK, with parties like Vox, Fratelli d'Italia, PiS, RN, and Reform UK advocating for stricter controls on immigration and welfare access.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Proposes 'national priority' in municipal aid and housing in Castelló, and demands changes to mail-in voting laws to prevent alleged fraud by Sánchez.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Meloni's housing plan faces criticism for insufficient social housing, while Salvini pushes for infrastructure projects prioritizing Italians.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: Advocates for policies favoring Polish citizens in healthcare and social benefits, criticizing opposition for prioritizing migrants.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Bardella confirms RN's exclusion from Marc Bloch's Panthéonization, signaling alignment with anti-immigration and national priority rhetoric.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Farage demands stricter immigration controls and criticizes Burnham for not prioritizing British citizens in welfare policies.

themes.title: Trump-Meloni diplomatic fallout escalates
themes.blurb: The diplomatic rift between U.S. President Donald Trump and Italian Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni has intensified, with both leaders engaging in public disputes over NATO commitments, trade policies, and personal insults. This theme resonates in the U.S., Italy, France, and Spain, reflecting broader transatlantic tensions within right-wing alliances.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Trump publicly insults Meloni, calling her 'weak' and accusing Italy of abandoning U.S. interests in the Iran conflict.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Meloni responds to Trump's criticism by emphasizing Italy's strategic autonomy and NATO commitments, while her ministers downplay the dispute.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: RN figures comment on the dispute, framing it as a broader challenge to European sovereignty and U.S. dominance.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Vox leaders criticize Meloni for perceived weakness in handling Trump, aligning with Trump's rhetoric on national sovereignty.

themes.title: Far-right leaders celebrate Colombia's election
themes.blurb: Right-wing and far-right leaders globally are celebrating the election of Colombia's far-right president, Abelardo de la Espriella, as a victory for conservative and nationalist movements. This theme appears in Argentina, the U.S., Spain, and France, highlighting a shared enthusiasm for right-wing electoral successes in Latin America.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Javier Milei congratulates de la Espriella, framing his victory as part of a broader Latin American shift toward liberal and conservative governance.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Trump and his allies praise de la Espriella's win, linking it to their own political agenda and anti-leftist rhetoric.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Vox leaders highlight de la Espriella's victory as evidence of a global right-wing resurgence and a rejection of leftist policies.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: RN figures express support for de la Espriella, framing his win as a victory for nationalist and anti-immigration movements.

themes.title: Internal divisions within far-right parties
themes.blurb: Far-right parties across Europe and the Americas are grappling with internal divisions over leadership, policy direction, and electoral strategies. This theme is evident in Italy, Germany, Argentina, the UK, and Hungary, where factions within parties like Fratelli d'Italia, AfD, La Libertad Avanza, Reform UK, and Fidesz are clashing publicly.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: AfD faces internal strife over leadership and policy, with factions clashing over strategy for upcoming elections.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza

themes.title: Judicial and corruption scandals in far-right governments
themes.blurb: Corruption scandals and judicial investigations are plaguing far-right governments and parties, with high-profile figures facing allegations of illicit enrichment, misuse of public funds, and unethical behavior. This theme is prominent in Argentina, Spain, the U.S., and Poland, where leaders and officials are under scrutiny.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Manuel Adorni faces allegations of illicit enrichment and misuse of public funds, with opposition pushing for his removal.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Vox leaders criticize the PSOE government for corruption, while a Vox councilwoman faces fraud allegations.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Trump administration officials face investigations and firings over corruption allegations, including misuse of intelligence agencies.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: PiS officials face allegations of corruption and misuse of public funds, including a scandal involving a hospital director.
